Communication Coach v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides Socratic questioning (挑刺) to simulate challenging real-world communication scenarios.
- Translates complex or technical language into simple, audience-friendly speech (降维表达).
- Helps users prepare for key communications: handling doubts, simplifying messages, and rehearsal for important meetings.
- Outputs practical, ready-to-use scripts tailored to context, audience, and goals.
- Supports flexible modes: critique-only, translation-only, full workflow, or role-change scenarios.
- Ensures feedback is challenging but constructive, focusing on improving clarity and resilience.
